design.freshSeedRule: serverSeed = sha256(label) as lowercase hex; clientSeed = label

bands.drawsPerRound: n (target game, multi toss) or C x F (coins x flips)
bands.seedLabels: each setting on its own seed labels

pass2.earlyWindow: nonces 1..n, n = the epoch's captured depth
pass2.statistic: per-slot standardised return: Σ (return − mean_s)/sd_s over the scored slots, ÷ √slots; mean_s and sd_s exact from the played setting's law
pass2.units: slotBets[j] / slotRet4[j] = slots replaying the epoch's j-th played setting and the sum of their multipliers in 1e-4 units; ret4 = sum of multipliers in 1e-4 units; mean = sum of E[mult4] x 2^100; var = sum of Var[mult4] x 2^200, each from the setting's exact law (src/rules.ts)
